To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) the proposed SOA-based RADICAL platform enables the retrieval and analysis, through the use of a set of algorithms, of big datasets stemming both from IoT devices and SN sites, collected by smart applications, and b) the application of sentiment analysis to the collected IoT and SN data is feasible and can provide valuable insights to smart city applications.
the proposed platform enables the efficient retrieval, analysis, visualization and dissemination of IoT and SN data, in the context of smart city applications.
the use of a database system, in combination with the use of a distributed computing system, can be used for the analysis of big IoT and social networking datasets in the context of smart cities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a SOA-based platform, capable of processing large volumes of data, collected from IoT devices and SN services.

the development of a scalable platform for the collection and processing of big data from SN and IoT sources, as well as with the application of data analytic techniques for the analysis of such data.

the following: (a) the retrieval of large datasets from IoT devices and SN sites; (b) the integration of the retrieved data into a SOA-based platform; (c) the development of data analytics algorithms and configurations to minimize the delay of results; and (d) the development of a set of smart city applications that use the data analytics algorithms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RADICAL platform can be considered a valuable tool in the context of smart city applications, enabling the analysis of big datasets and their integration with other city services.

the proposed architecture and the developed algorithms can be applied to any city application, as long as the application can be mapped into the proposed architecture and as long as the algorithmic improvements can be applied.

, in the context of smart cities, IoT and social networking datasets can be combined, processed and analyzed, with the aim of improving city services and citizen experience, while also providing a solid basis for future research in the area of Big Data analysis and processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have created a platform for the collection and analysis of Big IoT and Social Networking Data, in the context of smart cities, and that the platform can be used for the analysis of large amounts of data and the creation of applications based on the analysis of the data.

the proposed architecture is able to provide real-time analysis on large datasets of IoT and SN data, while the proposed algorithmic improvements on the data analytics are able to provide results in a timely fashion.
the RADICAL platform is able to process and analyse big data sets stemming from IoT devices and social networking sites, and to produce results in a reasonable amount of time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RADICAL platform is able to process and analyze in a scalable and efficient manner large amounts of data, while providing a flexible interface for data analytics and visualization.

a SOA-based platform is capable of handling the processing of big IoT datasets and SN data, and the analysis thereof, while the proposed algorithmic and configurations are able to minimize the delays of dataset processing and results’ retrieval, thus improving the performance of big data analysis.

the combination of the IoT with the Social Web is an important step towards the development of smart cities and their applications, and that the use of data analytics on the combined datasets is an important step in the development of smart city applications.
